name: Scorpion Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with arms out to the sides in a T, legs extended, chin resting on the mat.
Bend one knee to about 90 degrees and lift that foot off the floor.
Reach the lifted foot across the body toward the floor on the opposite side, letting the hip rotate.
Stop when you feel the stretch through the hip flexor, glute, and lower back of the lifted leg; keep the chest and shoulders pressed down.
Hold for the set time, return to start, and repeat on the other side.
